title: REHEARSE: Experiential Rehearsal for Verbal Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2508.14390v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often express verbal confidence that is poorly aligned with actual correctness, limiting their reliability in safety-critical applications. Existing prompt-based methods treat calibration largely as a one-shot inference problem, relying on either instance-level reasoning or post-hoc self-assessment. We introduce Rehearse (Experiential Rehearsal), a training-free method that instead enables models to adapt from their own scored confidence experience. In a credence-calibration game grounded in a strictly proper scoring rule, the model receives feedback on prior confidence decisions; this experience is summarized in a post-game trajectory prefix that captures systematic over- or under-confidence. At inference time, the model applies this cross-instance calibration signal to the chain-of-thought reasoning trace for each new question. translated_title: REHEARSE：大型语言模型中言语自信度校准的经验预演
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常常表达的言语自信度与实际正确性不一致，这限制了它们在安全关键应用中的可靠性。现有的基于提示的方法将校准主要视为一次性推理问题，依赖于实例级推理或事后自我评估。我们引入了Rehearse（经验预演），一种无需训练的方法，使模型能够从自身评分的自信经验中适应。在一个基于严格适当评分规则的信用校准游戏中，模型会收到关于先前自信决策的反馈；这一经验被总结为赛后轨迹前缀，捕捉系统性的过度自信或自信不足。在推理时，模型将这种跨实例校准信号应用于每个新问题的思维链推理轨迹。在四个LLM、三个基准和五个随机种子中，Rehearse的表现优于基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的校准方法Rehearse，通过让模型在评分游戏中积累自信经验并应用于推理过程，显著提升了大语言模型言语自信度与实际正确性的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Rehearse, a training-free calibration method that enables LLMs to adapt from scored confidence experience in a scoring game, significantly improving alignment between verbal confidence and actual correctness.
